Small adult dark eyes under low lids; no large white rectangle, no eye sparkle. Hair/scarf 3–4 connected masses each, no stripes. Match the supporting references' coarse hard-edged 74x100 logical pixel technique, <=32 earthy flat colors, no antialiasing, no blur, no dithering.
One fresh portrait only, true transparent background. No text, border, scene, hands, keys, pot, symbols, badges, medicine, additional character or implied cured state. Preserve identity and required garment colors while fixing age, eyes and composition.
